findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Two cans of Jalapeño cheese sauce were observed to be dented. PIC was made aware. The cans were removed from the inventory and stored separately to be returned. Ensure that all food product with compromised package integrity are removed from stock to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT - The caulking on the triple sink on the 4th flow was observed to be in disrepair. Discussed with PIC and PIC mentioned that they work order has been put in because all maintenance work has to go through the hospital. The cafe is located in the Springfield Clinic’s main campus east wing. Ensure that the necessary repair is done to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The Quaternary ammonium sanitizer in the coffee bar was observed to only be at 100ppm. CORRECTED- Another sanitizer tablet was added and the sanitizer tested to be at 200ppm. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer is frequently tested and changed or more is added if not at the correct concentration. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The shelves of the single door standing freezer are observed to be in need of a cleaning. Ensure that these shelves are routinely cleaned to prevent the accumulation of soil residues. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: FIRST REPEAT- The triple sink in the 4th floor kitchen and the prep table wall in the 4th floor kitchen are observed to be in need of repair. The caulking of the triple sink needs to be resealed and the wall by the prep table needs a fresh coat of paint or another solution to create a smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable solution.

The handwashing sink caulking is in a state of disrepair and needs to be re-caulked. Ensure that it is caulked and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

(A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use
findings.comment:
2-401.11: At the start of the inspection an employee was observed drinking and storing their drink on the surface of the small prep table. This behavior was corrected, the surface was sanitized, and employees were reminded to utilize designated employee areas for drink storage. Ensure employees consume beverages and store them in a manner that does not present the possibility for contamination of the food.
2-401.11: (A) EMPLOYEE SHALL eat, drink, or use tobacco in designated areas away from FOOD and FOOD-RELATED areas. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEE may drink from closed BEVERAGE Container if handled to prevent: (1) hands (2) container (3) FOOD and FOOD-RELATED ITEMS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The bottom of the prep coolers, the standing coolers, and the freezer in the 4th floor kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of food debris/soils. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The magnetic knife holder in the kitchen is observed to have an accumulation of food reside/soil on the top portion of the holder that is not in contact with the blades of the knife. This was brought to the staff’s attention and will be included in their nightly cleaning routine this evening. Ensure that the NonFOOD contact surface of equipment is regularly cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The chemical sanitizer dispenser was observed at 0ppm with an empty sanitizer bottle. PIC is making a trip to GFS to obtain QUAT tablets. The delivery truck for today was cancelled until tomorrow and the facility will have new bottles of sanitizer at this time. The spray bottles were tested and recorded at 150ppm QUAT and will be sufficient in sanitizing surfaces for today, PIC will have the QUAT tablets available before any dishes are completed for their wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop was observed to be stored in the basin of the mop bucket. The mop was placed into the top portion of the mop bucket during inspection. Ensure the mop is allowed to properly air dry to prevent the accumulation of bacteria and other potential contaminates on the mop head.
After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
